name: problem-callouts
description: Problem section: centred heading and lede over a photo ringed by floating callout chips, a closing note and a panda CTA bar. Live: the `.ap-problem` section on every vertical and hub page.

kicker.description: Bold line under the lede, e.g. That works — until it doesn't.

image.description: Photo at the centre of the stage.

background.description: Soft background image behind the section.

cards.description: Callout chips around the photo; the first five take the design's placements. Each: text (required); optional icon (URL), icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt, tone (indigo, rose, mint, slate, amber), x, y, w (px on the stage, used from 1181px) to place it as the page does, and bands: live's computed placement per width band, keyed 1181, 1025, 901 and 769, each {pos, l, r, t, w, minw, maxw (lengths or keywords), ws (nowrap or normal), fg, fb (the text's flex grow and basis)}.

cta_accent.description: Second line of the CTA heading, painted with the brand gradient.

cta_logo.description: Small mark beside the CTA copy: a file in assets/ or a URL.

cta_label.description: CTA button text. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_accent_inline.description: Run the CTA accent on the heading line instead of below it (live Local Government and Public Works).

cta_nowrap.description: Keep the CTA heading on one line from 769px (live Public Works).

phone.description: Phone spacing in px, as live measures it: stage_mt (extra space above the photo), gap (between photo and chips), note_mt (note offset), pb_m and pb_s (bottom padding at 561-768px and at 560px and below).
